capabilities: Capture clipboard text and images into the active note in the background
Insert content using reusable text templates (Raw, Bullet, Timestamped, Callout, custom)
Toggle watch mode with a single hotkey or ribbon icon
Scope sessions to text only, images only, or both
Show watch state, target note, scope, and format in the status bar
extras: Desktop only: clipboard polling relies on Electron clipboard APIs that are unavailable on mobile, so the plugin will not install there.
motivation: Built for capturing a stream of screenshots and snippets (e.g. live-noting a meeting) without ever switching back to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian only inserts clipboard content when you switch to it and paste manually, which breaks capture workflows like copying screenshots during a meeting.
summary: Background clipboard watcher that automatically inserts copied text and images into a pinned note at the cursor, even when Obsidian is not focused.
